benchmark_preflight_failures: The initial campaign completed all control samples, then rejected trace traffic.stop.requests before any trace measurement.

A subsequent trace warmup rejected missing hash_ids; another rejected insufficient hash block capacity. Final identical traces contain two unique 512-token blocks per request, covering 512/640/768-token prompts. No measured trace samples were discarded.

golden_change_causes.chunked_prefill: Every chunk pays its actual four-stage pass; smaller communication overhead changes queueing and per-request timing.
golden_change_causes.four_stage: Separate transfer servers replace the previous sum-of-transfers bottleneck; prefill can be faster. Decode is unchanged where the same compute bottleneck controls every sample.
golden_change_causes.two_stage: The renamed case now occupies two continuous resource groups and pays every complete pass, replacing the previous three-microbatch full-overlap formula with amortized fill.

golden_refresh.command: python/aisimulate/.venv/bin/python scripts/afd_parity.py refresh-e2e --case all --reason <ordered-stage modeling change>
golden_refresh.description: Layer-time anchors retained unchanged. Six CLI summaries regenerated with lifecycle/accounting equality checks; the retired amortized case renamed to two-stage with original description retained as historical attribution. Qualification schema=2, topology schema=3.

history_fold.behavior: Fold implementation into the original model/scheduler/caller commits; replace the removed amortized feature commit with the two-stage fixture; retain KV-capacity and PD/chunk boundaries. Update commit messages and documentation schema references.
history_fold.qualification: Recorded numerical and host measurements refer to the preserved pre-fold source snapshot. History rewrite and documentation changes do not require refreshing numerical goldens.

host_assessment: Full CLI paired median ratios are 1.0010 (control), 1.0054 (four-stage trace), 1.0035 (two-stage trace). Native replay ratios are 1.0218, 1.0381, 1.0013 with ranges recorded below. The four-stage recurrence adds necessary bounded arithmetic per prediction; common depths allocate nothing, factor=1 reuses the diagnostic result, no per-layer replay events or extra stage data queries. Results include variation and are not a formal statistical no-regression claim.

scope.cli_ms: fresh CLI process, including startup, construction, replay and output
scope.native_replay_ms: Replayer::run_inner through collector finalization; excludes model construction and output

limits: Uniform per-layer durations and largest-microbatch pricing retained.
Host samples run sequentially with alternating arm order on the same Mac, without CPU affinity or memory instrumentation. No concurrent builds/tests during samples.
Forward-only gate does not exercise this AFD pipeline integration; full CLI and native replay comparisons used instead.

model.complexity: O(K*m*layers) time, O(K+m) scratch; no allocation for m<=4. Transfer queries stay raw. Billed factors applied once per sample before grouping.
model.pass: Each microbatch completes its current layer before entering the next; stages process the same round-robin order. Every pass starts empty and drains.
model.sampling: Full configured batch and KV stride retained for fixed synthetic traffic; average evaluated billed passes rather than re-evaluating averaged stages. Instantaneous decode retains min(configured_m, per_worker) geometry.
model.search: Layout is fixed for each recommendation domain, including pinned shapes; omitted pinned layout inherits the fixed setting and explicit conflicting layouts fail.

scope: Intentional AFD numerical modeling change and simulator host-cost comparison; not measured serving accuracy or a replay-loop-only performance gate.
